select c.id,c.user_id,c.target_id,c.content,c.target_type as type,c.created_time, u.username,u.avatar, case when c.target_type = 1 then s.music_name -- 歌曲名 when c.target_type = 2 then p.playlist_name -- 歌单名 when c.target_type = 3 then a.album_name -- 专辑名 when c.target_type = 4 then cp.title -- 动态名 when c.target_type = 5 then m.mv_name -- mv名 else 'null' end as title from comment c left join user u on c.user_id = u.id left join music s on c.target_type = 1 and c.target_id = s.id left join playlist p on c.target_type = 2 and c.target_id = p.id left join album a on c.target_type = 3 and c.target_id = a.id left join community_post cp on c.target_type = 4 and c.target_id = cp.id left join music_mv m on c.target_type = 5 and c.target_id = m.id
c.status=1
and c.target_type=#{type}
and (c.content like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or u.username like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
order by c.created_time desc
select c.id,c.user_id,c.target_id,c.content,c.target_type as type,c.created_time, u.username,u.avatar from comment c left join user u on c.user_id = u.id where c.status=1 and c.id=#{id}
mapper.update: update comment set status=0 where id=#{id} and status=1
